open_points.subject: Cabinet Kernel authorization for pointer writes
open_points.text: “the agent publishes and withdraws pointers through Cabinet Kernel” conflicts with “A service publishes and withdraws none: its token has no such right,” because Cabinet Kernel authenticates with its own service token carrying agent authority
open_points.question: Does Kernel’s service token authorize publish and withdraw when accompanied by a registered session and project grant, or does some separately named credential or authority authorize these calls?
options: Kernel’s service token carries conditional agent authority
A separate agent-authority credential authorizes the call
open_points.default_guess: Kernel’s service token carries conditional agent authority, and Kernel is the transport caller while the session is the acting principal

open_points.subject: Recorded publisher identity
open_points.question: What exact principal does a pointer record for an agent publication: the agent session, Cabinet Kernel, a generic agent principal, or more than one of these?
options: Agent session id, with Kernel as authenticated caller
open_points.default_guess: Agent session id together with Cabinet Kernel as the authenticated caller

open_points.subject: Imported pointer publisher
open_points.text: “records who published it” and “never by that service” are silent about pointers imported from v1, where a producer service may have published the pointer
open_points.question: What publisher is recorded for an imported legacy pointer whose source has no publisher compatible with R0-88?
options: Preserve the historical producer service as legacy provenance
Record the owner who confirms the import
open_points.default_guess: Preserve the historical producer service as explicitly legacy provenance

open_points.subject: Imported artifact types outside the first-release vocabulary
open_points.text: “The first release declares one type, `estimate` by PresuPro” conflicts with the unchanged import promise to carry the selected projects’ pointers, ids and versions without saying that every imported pointer is an `estimate` owned by PresuPro
open_points.question: What happens if a selected VPS project contains a pointer whose type or owner service is not the first release’s declared `estimate`/PresuPro pair?
options: Preserve it as a readable legacy pointer
Drop that pointer while importing the project
Extend the release vocabulary before import
open_points.default_guess: Refuse the whole import until the release vocabulary covers every imported pointer

open_points.subject: Kernel-flow evidence
open_points.text: “Registry cannot check that the document exists, and the Kernel flow that made it is the evidence”
open_points.question: What observable evidence must exist, where is it retained, and who can read it, given that Registry stores no Kernel flow and an owner publication has no Kernel flow at all?
options: A retained Kernel run record is externally readable
The pointer’s publisher and request id are the only evidence
The owner’s submission is the evidence for owner publications
The sentence is rationale and creates no evidence promise
open_points.default_guess: Treat the pointer’s attribution and request id as Registry’s evidence, and the owner’s authenticated submission as the evidence for an owner publication
